name: cgc-og-image
description: Quartz 5 cards for shared links: stock og-image with last-segment tag chips, a configurable icon, and no generation under serve. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here. Stock og-image is the plugin this one wraps; every stock Quartz carries it, and @quartz-community/* is a shared scope the loader expects to find beside a plugin, never inside it.
//devDependencies: Inlined into dist by build.mjs, or the build tool itself: stock og-image bundles reading-time rather than exporting it, and the card counts minutes the same way. esbuild is here so the build never borrows the host's toolchain (ADR-0005).
